operations.name: selection.all
operations.description: Select the whole document.

operations.name: selection.color_range
operations.description: Select pixels document-wide by soft color similarity on the flattened composite. Use sampled color(s) or a preset range; fuzziness is 0-200 and defaults to 40.

color.description: [r, g, b] reference color; default is foreground color

preset.description: Preset range instead of sampled colors

mode.description: How to combine with the existing selection

operations.name: selection.column
operations.description: Select a single 1px-wide document column at x.

mode.description: How to combine with the existing selection

feather.description: Feather radius in px (softens the edge)

operations.name: selection.ellipse
operations.description: Select an ellipse inscribed in the given rect (doc coordinates).

mode.description: How to combine with the existing selection

feather.description: Feather radius in px (softens the edge)

operations.name: selection.feather
operations.description: Feather (soften) the current selection by a radius in px.

operations.name: selection.grow
operations.description: Select ▸ Grow/Similar: extend the selection to pixels matching its average color within tolerance — adjacent only (grow) or document-wide (similar).

operations.name: selection.invert
operations.description: Invert the current selection.

operations.name: selection.load
operations.description: Load a named saved selection. mode defaults to replace; add/subtract/intersect combine with the current selection.

mode.description: How to combine with the existing selection

operations.name: selection.magnetic
operations.description: Magnetic lasso: snap each input polygon point to the strongest nearby luminance edge on the flattened composite, then select the snapped polygon.

radius.description: Legacy alias for width in px (default 12)

mode.description: How to combine with the existing selection

feather.description: Feather radius in px (softens the edge)

operations.name: selection.modify
operations.description: Morph the selection: expand, contract, border (band around the edge), or smooth, by a radius in px.

operations.name: selection.none
operations.description: Deselect — clear the selection so edits affect the whole canvas again.

operations.name: selection.object
operations.description: Object Selection: heuristic GrabCut-style segmentation seeded by a rough rectangle (x/y/w/h) or lasso polygon (points) around an object — the selection snaps to the object inside. Color k-means models + edge-aware smoothing on the flattened composite; NOT ML, so it works best on color-separable objects.

points.description: Lasso mode instead of rect: flat [x1,y1,x2,y2,...], ≥3 points

mode.description: How to combine with the existing selection

feather.description: Feather radius in px (softens the edge)

sample_all_layers.description: Sample flattened visible document instead of only active raster layer

operations.name: selection.options
operations.description: Get or set selection-tool options used by marquee, lasso, magic wand, and quick selection. Pass only fields to change.

style.description: Marquee style: normal, fixed-ratio, or fixed-size

width.description: Marquee W field: ratio unit or fixed-size width in px

height.description: Marquee H field: ratio unit or fixed-size height in px

tolerance.description: Magic wand / quick selection color tolerance, 0-255

sample_size.description: Magic wand sample size in px; rounded to an odd value from 1 to 101

sample_all_layers.description: Sample flattened visible document instead of only the active raster layer

hard_edge.description: Quick Selection hard-edge mask; false softens stamp edges

magnetic_width.description: Magnetic Lasso edge-search width in px

magnetic_frequency.description: Magnetic Lasso automatic anchor spacing in px

object_mode.description: Object Selection drag mode: rect or lasso

operations.name: selection.polygon
operations.description: Select a closed polygon. points is a flat array [x1,y1,x2,y2,...] in doc coordinates.

mode.description: How to combine with the existing selection

feather.description: Feather radius in px (softens the edge)

operations.name: selection.quick_select
operations.description: Quick Selection: union or subtract contiguous flood selections from explicit stamp centers on the flattened composite. points is a flat [x1,y1,x2,y2,...] array in doc coordinates; default mode is add.

mode.description: How to combine with the existing selection (default add)

sample_all_layers.description: Sample flattened visible document instead of only active raster layer

hard_edge.description: Keep stamp edges hard; false softens the selection edge

operations.name: selection.quickmask
operations.description: Enter or exit Quick Mask mode. Entering converts the current selection to a paintable grayscale mask and clears the live selection; exiting converts that mask back to a selection.

enabled.description: true enters Quick Mask; false exits it

operations.name: selection.rect
operations.description: Select a rectangle in doc coordinates.

mode.description: How to combine with the existing selection

feather.description: Feather radius in px (softens the edge)

operations.name: selection.refine
operations.description: Select and Mask / Refine Edge: smooth, feather, contrast, then shift edge. output defaults to selection; layer_mask, new_layer, and new_layer_mask mirror the workspace outputs.

operations.name: selection.reselect
operations.description: Restore the last deselected selection, if one exists.

operations.name: selection.row
operations.description: Select a single 1px-tall document row at y.

mode.description: How to combine with the existing selection

feather.description: Feather radius in px (softens the edge)

operations.name: selection.save
operations.description: Save the current selection mask under a name for later loading.

operations.name: selection.subject
operations.description: Select Subject: heuristic segmentation of the main subject — background color models are seeded from the document border and the largest central foreground regions are kept. NOT ML (Photoshop uses a trained model); expect rougher results on busy scenes.

mode.description: How to combine with the existing selection

feather.description: Feather radius in px (softens the edge)

sample_all_layers.description: Sample flattened visible document instead of only active raster layer

operations.name: selection.transform
operations.description: Transform the current selection mask itself: scale/rotate about selection center and/or translate. One undoable step.

operations.name: selection.wand
operations.description: Magic wand: select pixels similar in color to the one at (x, y) on the flattened composite.

sample_size.description: Average sample size in px; rounded to an odd value from 1 to 101

sample_all_layers.description: Sample flattened visible document instead of only active raster layer

mode.description: How to combine with the existing selection

feather.description: Feather radius in px (softens the edge)
